lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate the 25 gitAvailable probe declarations to the helper

openQuestions: AC1's oracle (grep for `(const|let) gitAvailable *=`) also matches a plain local re-derivation like `const gitAvailable = isAvailable('git');` -- it is not satisfied by swapping the RHS from spawnSync to the helper's isAvailable() while keeping a local const. The only oracle-satisfying shape is a pure `import { gitAvailable } from '../helpers/test-deps.ts';` at each of the 25 call sites, which required adding a new `export const gitAvailable = isAvailable('git');` convenience binding to test-deps.ts itself (not present after US-001/US-002). Future stories reading test-deps.ts's public surface should be aware `gitAvailable` (precomputed boolean) now sits alongside `isAvailable`/`getDepInfo` as a named export, kept only because ~25 skipIf call sites already reference the identifier `gitAvailable` verbatim.

CAM-432 (explicitly out of scope here, per this story's notes) still needs to delete the now-provably-dead `test.skipIf(!gitAvailable)(...)` gates once git is confirmed to be a true hard dependency everywhere in CI; the call sites were deliberately left untouched by this story.
nextStoryContext: US-003 migrated all 25 non-helper `const/let gitAvailable = spawnSync('git', ['--version'], ...)` declarations to `import { gitAvailable } from '../helpers/test-deps.ts';`, adding one new export (`gitAvailable: boolean = isAvailable('git')`) to test-deps.ts (US-001) to satisfy AC1's oracle, which forbids ANY `const|let gitAvailable =` binding outside test/helpers or test/fixtures -- a local `const gitAvailable = isAvailable('git');` re-derivation still trips that grep, so a pure import is the only shape that passes. Every `test.skipIf(!gitAvailable)(...)` call site was left untouched (that's CAM-432, explicitly out of scope). All 73 real `spawnSync('git', [...])` wire-boundary calls (ADR-0039 must-survive inventory) are untouched -- only the 25 `--version` probe declarations, which the AC14 regex explicitly excludes via negative lookahead, were removed. Verified live: full-PATH `bun test` = 5702 pass / 0 fail / exit 0 / no skip-summary-line (same floor as US-002, no shrinkage since no tests were added/removed, only refactored); `bun run typecheck` clean; `bun run check:all` full spine green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps). test/fixtures/version-skip-guard/** untouched (git diff/status both empty). A handful of the 25 files had a now-vacant `// Skip guard` comment-section header (3-line separator block with nothing left under it after the declaration moved to an import) or a doubled blank line where the declaration used to sit; both were cleaned up in the same commit as a direct, in-scope consequence of removing the declaration line (not a broader refactor). The next centralization tranche this unblocks: any remaining scattered `Bun.which`/`spawnSync(--version)` probes for the other 6 tracked binaries (tmux, jq, pgrep, ps, uuidgen, bun) across test/**, per test-deps.ts's module doc comment (still describes ~46 total scattered call sites pre-US-003; git's 25 are now migrated, ~21 remain across the other binaries plus CAM-432's dead-gate deletion).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.which(name) returns string|null (found path vs not found), matching test-deps.ts's `probe()` (Bun.which(name) !== null), which this story's new `gitAvailable` export transitively depends on. No production code in test-deps.ts was changed by this story beyond adding the new export; behavior is unchanged.
